result: For the explicitly defined 4x12 PPT/SN3 Horodecki-crosshatch source R and EVERY complex Bob map K:C^12->C^4, the nonzero output sigma_K=(I tensor K)R(I tensor K)^* satisfies tr(P sigma_K)/tr(sigma_K)<3/5, where P is the explicit rank3-subspace projector below. Since one normalized SR2 ket has overlap 2925/3074>3/5 with P, no 2-block-positive witness lambda I-P can detect any of these outputs. The proof uses an exact positive 48x48 quadratic pencil and covers arbitrary non-coordinate K, but NOT arbitrary additional Alice filters or all PPT states.
source: R is the unnormalized trace44 explicit H tensor Q/Pi source independently proved PPT/SN3 in frontier-20261028-hor-crosshatch-source-sn3-and-erratum-v1.json SHA256 011197ff21428df54cd65cb55f1f09c7c8c7931f9242ad2f3e80b95a0eaa9827. The printed Eq.36/E3 list is a DIFFERENT NPT density, so no source-list substitution is made. Let its 20 unnormalized real source kets be q_j in C^4 tensor C^12, as reconstructed by the exact source checker.
rank3_subspace: Let D=diag(1,5,-9,3), U be the first superdiagonal shift and L=U^T. S=span{I4,D,U,L} has every nonzero matrix rank>=3: if the U coefficient is nonzero the minor rows0,1,2/cols1,2,3 equals its cube; otherwise if the L coefficient is nonzero the reverse minor equals its cube; if both vanish, distinct D entries ensure aI+bD has at most one zero diagonal. Its orthogonal projector is P=(1/4)[I4]+(1/116)[D]+(1/3)[U]+(1/3)[L]. For the SR2 ket q=5|11>-9|22>, <q|P|q>/<q|q>=2925/3074. Therefore 2-block-positivity of lambda I-P forces lambda>=2925/3074.
quadratic_pencil: Flatten the complex 4x12 filter K as x_(b,s)=K_(b,s). Define G_(b,s),(c,t)=delta_bc*sum_(j,a) conjugate(q_j[a,s])*q_j[a,t] and H_(b,s),(c,t)=sum_(j,a,d) conjugate(q_j[a,s])*P_(a,b),(d,c)*q_j[d,t]. Then tr(sigma_K)=x^*Gx and tr(P sigma_K)=x^*Hx. The exact checker builds G,H over Q(sqrt2) and verifies 3G-5H is positive definite by48 positive Schur pivots. Thus for every nonzero K, tr(P sigma_K)<(3/5)tr(sigma_K). Since 2925/3074>3/5, every 2-block-positive lambda I-P has strictly positive expectation on every normalized nonzero output. This conclusion does not require knowing the exact 2-block-positivity threshold.
non_copt_caveat: The previous generic projector example was coCP, but that is NOT assumed here: for this differently ordered D, x=|13>+2|22>+|31> gives <x|(I-P^Gamma)|x>=-106/87, so even I-P need not be coCP. It remains PSD as I minus an orthogonal projector. The proven exclusion is source-wide for Bob filters, not a universal decomposability theorem.

exact_check.observed: Exact Q(sqrt2) Schur elimination verifies all48 pivots of 3G-5H positive, checks P^2=P, the rational rank2 overlap 2925/3074, and the -106/87 PT test. The checker hash-pins and replays the prior source/495-cut construction. The all-filter statement is the exact quadratic-form identity above.

limits: Fixed Alice identity after the source's Pi_A, one CES projector, and arbitrary Bob filters only; an additional Alice filter changes the pencil. This neither proves SN<=2 for outputs nor rules out other witnesses/filters or generic 4x4 PPT SN3. No novelty, external/formal review or publication.
